title: JTAG Boundary Scan
description: Tests board interconnects with JTAG boundary scan without physical probes. Scan cells drive and sample every pin; EXTEST finds opens and shorts between chips. It tests what bed-of-nails cannot reach.

demo.title: Demo — JTAG Boundary Scan

title: POST Code Diagnosis
description: Reads power-on self-test codes to find where boot hangs. Each checkpoint writes a code to port 0x80; the last code before the hang names the suspect. A two-dollar POST card diagnoses dead boards.
key_mechanisms: Read the last code on hang

demo.title: Demo — POST Code Diagnosis

title: Built-In Self-Test
description: Runs logic BIST with on-chip pattern generators and signature analyzers. Pseudo-random patterns test the logic; signatures compress the results. It tests silicon without external equipment.

demo.title: Demo — Built-In Self-Test

title: Marching Memory Tests
description: Tests RAM with marching patterns that catch stuck-at and coupling faults. March C walks ones and zeros through every cell in both directions; it is the standard memory test. memtest86 implements the classics.

demo.title: Demo — Marching Memory Tests

title: ECC Error Injection
description: Injects ECC errors to verify correction and reporting paths. If the injection does not produce the expected corrected-error log, the ECC path is broken. It tests the safety net itself.

demo.title: Demo — ECC Error Injection

title: Signal Integrity Analysis
description: Measures eye diagrams and jitter to validate high-speed signals. Closed eyes mean bit errors; the analysis finds whether the transmitter, channel, or receiver is at fault. Every SerDes link needs it.

demo.title: Demo — Signal Integrity Analysis

title: Logic Analyzer Tracing
description: Captures digital waveforms with logic analyzers to debug protocol issues. Seeing the actual timing settles disputes between hardware and firmware teams. Protocol decoders translate waves to transactions.

demo.title: Demo — Logic Analyzer Tracing

title: CRC Fault Detection
description: Protects data in flight and at rest with CRCs that detect burst errors. Every frame carries its checksum; mismatches trigger retransmission. It is the cheapest reliable error detection.

demo.title: Demo — CRC Fault Detection

title: Sensor Validation
description: Validates sensor readings against physical plausibility and redundancy. A temperature jumping 50 degrees in a second is a faulty sensor, not physics; voting across redundant sensors isolates faults. It keeps control loops honest.

demo.title: Demo — Sensor Validation

title: Firmware Self-Tests
description: Runs firmware self-tests at boot: RAM, flash, clocks, and peripherals. Failures halt with a clear code instead of mysterious later crashes. It is the firmware's own health check.

demo.title: Demo — Firmware Self-Tests

title: Loopback Tests
description: Loops transmitter output back to the receiver to test the full path. Internal, external, and remote loopbacks isolate faults to segments. It is the first test for any serial link.

demo.title: Demo — Loopback Tests

title: Voltage Margining
description: Margins supply voltages up and down to find weak silicon before it fails in the field. Parts that only work at nominal voltage are marginal; margining finds them in manufacturing. It is how quality is proven.

demo.title: Demo — Voltage Margining

title: Clock Jitter Measurement
description: Measures clock jitter decomposed into random and deterministic components. Excess jitter closes eyes and causes bit errors; the measurement guides PLL tuning. Precision timing starts here.

demo.title: Demo — Clock Jitter Measurement

title: Fault Dictionaries
description: Builds dictionaries mapping observed failure signatures to root causes. Each signature — which tests failed — points to the likely fault; diagnosis becomes lookup. Manufacturing triage runs on dictionaries.

demo.title: Demo — Fault Dictionaries

title: RMA Triage
description: Triages returned hardware with a standard diagnostic flow to separate real faults from no-trouble-found. Consistent triage cuts warranty costs and finds systemic issues. Data feeds back to design.

demo.title: Demo — RMA Triage
